before.recommendedStart: Immediately after summiting via another route

sectionBreakdown.note: Five rappels (~400 ft) down the NE side, then an exposed, loose 3rd/4th-class ledge traverse across ~5 rock ribs back to the East Ridge crest, then down the standard East Ridge gully system to Boston Basin.
sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Summit to Boston Basin via East Ledges

after.recommendedStart: Immediately after summiting via another route

sectionBreakdown.note: Five rappels (~400 ft) down the NE side, then an exposed, loose 3rd/4th-class ledge traverse across ~5 rock ribs back to the East Ridge crest, then down the standard East Ridge gully system to Boston Basin.
sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Summit to Boston Basin via East Ledges

sectionBreakdown.note: Follow the climbers’ path down out of Boston Basin and through the forest to the trailhead.

before.recommendedStart: Early (dawn) start recommended to beat afternoon thunderstorms and other parties to the rap stations
